package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "maps"
    "os"
    "slices"
    "sync/atomic"
    "example.invalid/iteratorbridge/dispatch"
)

func semantics() {
    var empty map[int]string
    collected := maps.Collect(maps.All(empty))
    if collected == nil || len(collected) != 0 { panic("empty map collection changed") }
    source := map[int]string{1: "one", 2: "two", 3: "three"}
    collected = maps.Collect(maps.All(source))
    if !maps.Equal(collected, source) { panic("map collection changed") }
    target := map[int]string{1: "old", 4: "four"}
    maps.Insert(target, maps.All(source))
    if !maps.Equal(target, map[int]string{1: "one", 2: "two", 3: "three", 4: "four"}) {
        panic("map insertion or overwrite changed")
    }
    count := 0
    for key, value := range maps.All(source) {
        if source[key] != value { panic("map pair changed") }
        count++
        break
    }
    if count != 1 { panic("map iterator early stop changed") }
    keys := map[int]bool{}
    for key := range maps.Keys(source) { keys[key] = true }
    values := map[string]bool{}
    for value := range maps.Values(source) { values[value] = true }
    if !maps.Equal(keys, map[int]bool{1: true, 2: true, 3: true}) ||
        !maps.Equal(values, map[string]bool{"one": true, "two": true, "three": true}) {
        panic("map keys or values changed")
    }
    if !slices.Equal(slices.Collect(slices.Values([]int{3, 1, 4})), []int{3, 1, 4}) {
        panic("simultaneous slices selection changed")
    }
    fmt.Println("semantics=ok")
}

func main() {
    if len(os.Args) > 1 && os.Args[1] == "semantics" { semantics(); return }
    src := make(map[int]int, 1000000)
    for i := 0; i < 1000000; i++ { src[i] = i * 3 }
    var ran atomic.Bool
    if len(os.Args) == 1 || os.Args[1] != "alone" {
        start, ready := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
        go func() { close(ready); <-start; ran.Store(true) }()
        <-ready
        close(start)
    }
    dst := make(map[int]int, len(src))
    maps.Insert(dst, maps.All(src))
    siblingBeforeReturn := ran.Load()
    yieldsBeforeReturn := dispatch.Count()
    if !maps.Equal(dst, src) {
        panic("map iterator results changed")
    }
    fmt.Printf("sibling-before-return=%t len=%d checkpoint-yields=%d\n", siblingBeforeReturn, len(dst), yieldsBeforeReturn)
}
